the one parameter the run did not reproduce exactly, and it is not an error: the offset level names the cell and the speed that realises it was rounded to one figure. Reported as a deviation because no tolerance is declared, so anything other than exact is a person's to read (result_card)

targets.note: the person's, 2026-09-23: recover the known stiffness to one per cent. RELATIVE, and on the RECOVERED-OVER-INPUT RATIO rather than on a stiffness in pN/um -- that is what makes the target well posed against an E3 viscosity, since the same drag coefficient imposes the offset and inverts it and eta cancels out of the ratio. A target is a decision and carries no grade (5.3.1)

estimation.note: the registered estimator: the mean along-flow displacement from the DECLARED trap centre, over the declared record_length after startup_discard. The block standard error and the second route to the stiffness ride on the same trace and are not the estimator

new_facts.claim: On this workstation the trap_hoomd_backend integrator -- HOOMD-blue 7.2.0 on the CPU, its Brownian method, the trap as a harmonic bond to a tether outside the integration filter costs about 3 microseconds of wall clock per integration step, for one overdamped sphere in a harmonic trap under uniform flow.
new_facts.validity_conditions: trap_hoomd_backend as committed at the time of run-20260923-201-v5-k1-o2, one particle, three coordinates, a save every twenty steps, measured on 2026-09-23 over one run of 102500 steps while other sessions shared the machine. NOT the NumPy mock, whose figure is measured separately, and not a cost per particle-step for N above one: the 1000-particle hoomd_backend run run-20260922-hoomd-s3 cost 4 ms a step and 4 us a particle-step, and the figures do not interpolate. It answers the gap A5 found as cost_per_particle_step_overdamped_absent for this backend only.

numbers.name: temperature
numbers.note: a parameter of the noise amplitude and realised exactly by the model, not a thermostat setpoint. The room's reading; nothing actuates the sample (kb:sample_temperature_not_actuated)

numbers.name: viscosity
numbers.note: pure water, validity 288 to 298 K and the temperature above is inside it. THE ENTRY SAYS `of order` one mPa s, so this is one significant figure and the precision below says so

numbers.name: bead_diameter
numbers.note: the SI anchor: the particle in the bottle, measured directly. Sets the drag through Stokes and the soft end of the stiffness sweep through the thermal width

numbers.name: trap_stiffness_k1
numbers.note: the soft end of the range

numbers.name: flow_speed_k1_o2
numbers.note: the speed that puts the steady offset at this row's number of thermal widths, at this stiffness

numbers.name: integration_timestep_k1_o2
numbers.note: AT the binding A1 bound for this cell

numbers.name: save_interval_k1
numbers.note: A4's ceiling at this level

numbers.name: startup_discard_k1
numbers.note: A7's discard at this level, declared before the run and evaluated by the estimator on this number

numbers.name: record_length_k1_o2
numbers.note: the averaging window after the startup, sized for the target at the offset this cell REALLY has, with S4's 1.5x margin. The backend adds the startup

numbers.name: offset_over_sigma_o2
numbers.note: the decade between

numbers.name: target_relative_error
numbers.note: the person's, settled 2026-09-23, and it is a DECISION carrying no grade of its own (5.3.1). It sits in numbers[] only so the record lengths below can name it as an input; the authority is the goal's targets[]

numbers.name: deviation_limit_in_standard_errors
numbers.note: the person's choice on 2026-09-23: a cell's recovered stiffness passes when it differs from the declared one by at most three of that cell's own standard errors. A decision, carried as assumed: because a decision can be named by reference only when it is a target or an envelope limit

numbers.name: drag_offset_predicted
numbers.note: gamma*v/k_t from the plan's inputs: the steady offset the model predicts. ONE FIGURE because the sweep corners it stands on are declared order_of_magnitude, although the model realises them exactly. The comparison that carries precision is not this number but the recovered-over-declared ratio in criteria_evaluation, which is a ratio and so is set by the run

numbers.name: drag_offset_standard_error_predicted
numbers.note: sigma*sqrt(2*tau/T) at the declared record: the sampling error the OU model predicts for the mean. This is the claim the question is about, because the stiffness cancels out of it

numbers.name: max_step_displacement
numbers.note: the largest single-step displacement, which the divergence criterion watches against the bead diameter

numbers.name: relative_block_standard_error_of_drag_offset
numbers.note: the block standard error of the mean offset over the offset, from 42 blocks of ten declared relaxation times. statistics_met compares it against the person's target

numbers.name: deviation_of_stiffness_recovered_through_drag_in_standard_errors
numbers.note: |recovered over declared stiffness minus one| over the cell's own relative block standard error: the deviation counted in the run's own error bars, which the person's accuracy criterion compares

numbers.name: integration_timestep_actual
numbers.note: simulated time over the integer step count

numbers.name: save_interval_actual
numbers.note: simulated time over the number of intervals between saved frames

numbers.name: record_length_actual
numbers.note: the span of frames the estimator averaged, after startup_discard

numbers.name: offset_over_sigma_realised
numbers.note: the steady offset in thermal widths that the dispatched speed actually produces. The plan's axis LABELS the cell ten; the speed was derived from that label at one significant figure, and one figure of 19.09 um/s is 20

numbers.name: cost_per_step_measured
numbers.note: 0.283 s over 102500 steps of the integration loop alone, on trap_hoomd_backend, excluding process start and polling. A measurement of this workstation running this code, which is why it is `measured:` while the offset is not

assumptions.statement: The relative error target on the recovered stiffness is the person's and was given on 2026-09-23. It is not an estimate this axis made, and the `assumed:` prefix is the nearest source kind for a decision -- 5.3 has no kind for `a person chose this`, which is the same gap the run observable waits on from the other direction.
assumptions.falsifier: the person changes the target, which is a revision and not a correction; and an A5 collision at this target is a reason to raise it rather than evidence that it was wrong

assumptions.statement: Revision 4's accuracy criterion -- recovered within one per cent -- was met by a correct integrator only about three cells in four, because the cells' own error is near one per cent; in both attempts one cell of six missed, a different one each time. The person replaced it with a limit of three standard errors, under which a correct cell misses about 0.3 per cent of the time and six cells about 2 per cent.
assumptions.falsifier: a cell outside three standard errors in two independent seeds is a systematic error, not noise

kb_refs.claim: The particles in the bottle in use have a diameter of 5 micrometres, with a coefficient of variation no greater than 2 per cent, measured directly by the operator on 2026-09-19.
The laboratory's ambient temperature is 20 degrees Celsius, read off a thermometer by the operator. It is a reading and not a setpoint, and it is the room's rather than the sample's.
Dynamic viscosity of pure water near 293 K is of order one millipascal second, and it changes by roughly two percent per kelvin in that neighbourhood.
